description: Enrichment pipeline for NiFi system diagnostics - normalizes percentages and parses nested structures

script.source: if (ctx.usedHeapBytes != null && ctx.maxHeapBytes != null && ctx.maxHeapBytes > 0) { ctx.heapUtilization = (float)(ctx.usedHeapBytes * 100.0 / ctx.maxHeapBytes); }

if (ctx.contentRepositoryStorageUsage != null && ctx.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes != null && ctx.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes > 0) { long used = ctx.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes - ctx.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.freeSpaceBytes; ctx.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.usedSpaceBytes = used; ctx.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.utilization = (float)(used * 100.0 / ctx.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes); }

if (ctx.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage != null && ctx.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes != null && ctx.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes > 0) { long used = ctx.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes - ctx.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.freeSpaceBytes; ctx.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.usedSpaceBytes = used; ctx.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.utilization = (float)(used * 100.0 / ctx.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes); }

if (ctx.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage != null && ctx.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes != null && ctx.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes > 0) { long used = ctx.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes - ctx.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.freeSpaceBytes; ctx.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.usedSpaceBytes = used; ctx.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.utilization = (float)(used * 100.0 / ctx.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes); }
